_comment: Reference transcript documenting the '¿algo más? loop' bug (2026-04-17 21:30). The pre-loop negation resolver hook already handles the add_more_asked flag correctly (test_booking_add_more_loop.py passes). The BUG documented here is the DEEPER root cause: _build_flow_hint renders <flow_hint> XML into a cacheable SystemMessage. When OpenRouter prefix-cache returns a stale hit, the LLM reads _confirmation_shown=False from the XML and re-asks '¿algo más?' even though add_more_asked=True is set in booking_context live. This reference transcript describes the conversation pattern that triggers the bug and will be used in Batch 1 tests to assert the fix via StatusLineMiddleware [estado] HumanMessage.
root_cause: _build_flow_hint mutates ctx['_confirmation_shown']=True in-place (booking_mode.py:217) without returning the dict to the state. Additionally, <flow_hint> XML lives in a cacheable SystemMessage; when OpenRouter prefix-cache returns a stale hit, the LLM reads stale flow_hint state and re-asks questions already answered.

reproduction_conditions.expected_behavior: Agent advances to ask for stylist preference (add_more_asked is True)
reproduction_conditions.bug_behavior: Agent re-asks '¿Quieres añadir algo más?' ignoring add_more_asked=True in live state, because <flow_hint> XML in cached SystemMessage shows stale state

conversation_transcript.content: ¡Hola! Soy Maite, la asistente virtual de Atrévete. ¿En qué puedo ayudarte hoy?
¡Perfecto! ¿El corte es para señora, caballero, niño/a o bebé?
Genial, te apunto 'Corte Señora'. ¿Quieres añadir algo más a tu cita?

conversation_transcript.note: pre-loop negation resolver sets add_more_asked=True BEFORE LLM call. booking_context live: add_more_asked=True. BUT: <flow_hint> XML in cached SystemMessage still shows add_more_asked=False (stale prefix cache hit from OpenRouter)

conversation_transcript.content: ¿Quieres añadir algo más a tu cita?
conversation_transcript.note: BUG: Agent re-asks the same question. LLM read stale <flow_hint> from cached SystemMessage instead of live booking_context. _confirmation_shown=False in stale XML overrides the real state.

bug_evidence.discrepancy: add_more_asked in live context is True but <flow_hint> XML shows false due to OpenRouter prefix cache returning stale SystemMessage

expected_fix.description: StatusLineMiddleware injects fresh HumanMessage '[estado]' before each model call with live booking_context. booking.md updated to read '[estado]' as ground truth. _build_flow_hint deleted.
expected_fix.key_assertion_batch1: After fix: turn 8 agent_response does NOT contain '¿algo más?' OR '¿Quieres añadir' when add_more_asked=True and last_services is set

current_test_status.test_booking_add_more_loop.py: PASSES (5/5) — negation resolver hook is wired and works for the pre-loop detection. The deeper bug (stale <flow_hint> XML) is not yet fixed — Batch 1 addresses it via StatusLineMiddleware.
current_test_status.note: The test currently passes because it mocks build_layered_messages and create_agent, so the stale XML cache path is not exercised. The real bug only manifests with a live LLM call against OpenRouter with prefix caching enabled.
